notes:
Quick CRM snapshot and POC notes:
- Company: Sunfoundry Platforms (mid-market SaaS, product collaboration tooling). Domain sunfoundry.io. HQ: SF Bay Area. Team: CTO (Priya Malhotra), Head of Product (Liam Ortega), Eng Manager (Nina Park).
- Engagement summary: Started with Hosted API trial (14 days) to validate latency and token mix; positive dev experience, now evaluating Dedicated for predictable throughput and lower unit cost. AE Jordan P on pricing + Dedicated TCO, SE Riley on sizing.
- Hosted trial metrics (observed):
  * Trial window: 2026-02-01 -> 2026-02-14.
  * Average daily model requests: ~18k requests/day.
  * Peak QPS observed during feature release spike: 6.2 QPS (2-minute spike), sustained peak periods ~3.5 QPS.
  * Baseline concurrency: 3-5 concurrent streams during normal business hours; peak concurrency observed 9.
  * Token mix (by request count): ~62% short queries (<128 tokens), ~28% mid-length (128-512 tokens), ~10% long (>512 tokens).
  * Avg tokens/request (input+output): ~340 tokens. Embeddings: ~120k vectors/day during batch reindex window. Reranking: batch jobs of ~8-16 per search query.
  * Latency: median ~120ms on hosted for chat gen; p95 ~320ms. SLA goal: product team wants median <150ms, p95 <350ms for chat flows.
- Workload characteristics / constraints:
  * Primary flows: in-app chat assistant (session state + long context occasionally), semantic search (embedding vectors + nearest-neighbor), reranking for search relevance, server-side summarization jobs (background batching).
  * Traffic pattern: diurnal with product-release spikes (can increase QPS 2-3x for several hours). Weekly batch windows for embeddings/reindex. Predictable weekly cadence but with unpredictable release spikes.
  * Data needs: customer content indexed for search (must support data residency in US), audit logs required for regulatory customers. SSO required (SAML). KMS integration desired for key management.
- Dedicated sizing ask (requested by Sunfoundry after trial):
  * Goal: baseline platform to handle sustained 10-12 QPS with headroom for 3x release spikes and concurrent sessions ~12-18.
  * Initial proposal sketch (SE/Riley): 2 x 80GB-class GPUs for baseline sustained throughput for chosen model family, autoscale policy up to 6 GPUs for peaks (burst to 8 for short windows) — final sizing depends on model config (quantized vs fp16) and batch settings.
  * Embeddings: separate dedicated workers for batching (estimate 2 vCPU-heavy pods + 1 GPU for large vector batches), or use hosted embeddings during transition.
  * Expected concurrency profile: 4 steady workers for chat, ability to support 12 concurrent KV-cache sessions with efficient prefix caching.
- Cost and procurement notes:
  * Finance wants comparison: hosted per-token spend vs Dedicated committed monthly cost; target is ~20-30% reduction in unit cost vs hosted for committed volume.
  * Willing to consider 12-month commit if SLA + security requirements met.
- Security/compliance steps and status:
  * Submitted security questionnaire on 2026-02-10. Redwood provided SOC2 and ISO artifacts (redacted) 2026-02-18. Sunfoundry requested encryption-at-rest KMS details and audit log retention policy. SOC2 evidence still requested (blocker).
- Quotes and customer feedback:
  * CTO Priya: 'We need predictable latency during high-traffic releases; can't tolerate p95 >350ms on critical paths.'
  * Head of Product Liam: 'If Dedicated saves >25% and we can get private VPC + audit logs, we'll push procurement.'
